summary: Marian is opening at the Carlyle.

blocks.x: That's it. Marian, you are opening January 2nd at which hotel? (LAUGHTER).

At the Carlisle and I'm quite excited about it, this is a new room for me. I've never played there. And actually, it's really you might say Bobby Short's room. He's played there for so many years. And it is partly due to Bobby that I'm going in there. He was kind enough to suggest me as somebody to play there for the two months that he's away and naturally, I'm looking forward to it very much.
